name: Cedrick Albuero
title: Junior Full-Stack Developer & AI Integration Developer
availability: Open to full-time, part-time, internship, freelance, remote, hybrid, or on-site opportunities
bio_paragraphs: I am an IT student and aspiring software engineer with experience building full-stack web and mobile applications. My work focuses on business process automation, workflow systems, offline-first applications, and AI integration using modern technologies such as React.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, React Native, Firebase, and Python.

I have developed projects including an Electronic Business Permits and Licensing System (eBPLS) designed for government workflow automation and Hanap Medisina Offline, a React Native application that uses an on-device TensorFlow Lite model to identify Philippine medicinal plants without internet connectivity. Through these projects, I have gained experience in system architecture, REST API development, authentication, database design, payment integration, and mobile application development.

I enjoy solving real-world problems through technology and continuously improving my skills in software engineering, AI-assisted applications, scalable system design, and modern development practices. My goal is to build reliable, user-focused solutions that create meaningful impact.
engineering_values: I prioritize clean, maintainable, and readable code over unnecessary complexity.
I design systems with scalability, security, and long-term maintainability in mind.
I focus on solving real user problems through practical and efficient software solutions.
I value continuous learning, feedback, and iterative improvement throughout development.
